statements.quote: Natco's product is branded Semanat. Alkem's is Semasize. Sun Pharma sells two versions, Noveltreat and Sematrinity. Dr. Reddy's is Obeda.

source.title: Mad Honey, chapter 4: the pharmaceutical machine (Nir Strulovitz)

statements.price: India generic: $14 to $20 a month (1,300 to 1,800 rupees). US Ozempic: about $1,000 a month.
statements.approval: Indian patent on semaglutide expired on 20 March 2026; over forty legal Indian manufacturers.
